verdict.rationale: Jeeves is a fintech platform with a developer API, so an official CLI is a fair question to ask. The evidence documents REST APIs, TypeScript and Python SDKs, webhooks and an official MCP server, but never mentions a command-line tool. SDKs and the MCP server are adjacent developer surfaces and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
